title: Hyperbole (for Kids) — The Greatest Literary Device
skills: identify hyperbole in literary and everyday language
analyze how exaggeration creates emphasis, humor, and emotional effect
apply hyperbole intentionally in creative writing
alignment_note: Provides an accessible introduction to hyperbole as deliberate exaggeration used for emphasis, humor, imagery, and emotional effect. Although designed for younger learners, it can serve as review, intervention, or reinforcement of figurative-language analysis across high school English courses.
